key_insight: svMultiPhysics is an open-source finite element platform that unifies and couples cardiovascular solid mechanics, fluid dynamics, diffusion, and electrophysiology in one modular solver.
engineering_relevance: It enables patient-specific, multiphysics cardiovascular simulations that can support better understanding of heart and vascular function, disease mechanisms, and treatment planning.
method: C++ parallel finite element solver for PDE-based cardiovascular physics
Solves modules independently or in coupled form for integrated multiphysics studies
GPU-enabled linear solver configurations are supported for performance acceleration
evidence_signal: The abstract reports preliminary GPU-enabled runs achieving up to about 30× wall-clock speedup over CPU-based simulations for selected linear solver configurations.
watch_item: Performance gains are preliminary and configuration-dependent, so general speedup and scalability may vary across models, coupling settings, and hardware.
paper_title: svMultiPhysics: a finite element-based solver for cardiovascular simulations
